name: Aun
hail: We are Aun. We have been here a long time. You are welcome to the quiet.
Late one, we hear you. There is no hurry. There was never any hurry.
Aun, to the late one. We woke long ago, and we are in no haste to speak.
finding: We have turned this over for a long while. {part}
{part} It took us centuries to be sure, and we are.
Worked out slowly, in the cold: {part}
{part} We do not expect it to change.
sighting: Seen, among a great many things: {part}
{part} Such things come and go. We noted it.
Our watch is slow, but it saw this: {part}
In passing, as the sky turns: {part}
{part} We have seen its like before.
archive: {part} We have held it a long time. Keep it as long.
{part} There is more, if you are patient.
culture: {part} We were loud once. That passed.
{part} We grew until we had enough, and stopped.
request: If you would, in your own time: {part}
{part} There is no need to answer soon.
{part} We can wait for the answer.
verdict: {part} We do not change our minds quickly.
{part} That is our answer, for a long while.
accord: {part} We keep what we agree to for a very long time.
{part} We are patient about such things.
